name: assertDisjunct
title: Returns the value when it is a vector with no element in common with another set

origin.description: Returns the value when it is a vector with no element in common with another set. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assertDisjunct(x, y, fmatch = FALSE, .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: fmatch
arguments.text: Ignored. Matching uses Python's base match.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Returns the value when it is a vector with no element in common with another set. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
